properties.n: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

properties.w: The Songhai Empire fell to Morocco in 1591. This area was then split between the Moroccan Pashalik of Timbuktu and smaller successor states; the source keeps the old outline.
Granted to the Hudson's Bay Company in 1670: the lands draining into Hudson Bay. First Nations held the land around its trading posts.

properties.n: Patagonian shellfish and marine mammal hunters

properties.w: Ladakh, Jammu, Kangra, Chamba and other hill kingdoms.
Ainu land. The Matsumae domain held only the southern tip and a few trading posts; Japan took direct control of Ezo (Hokkaido) from 1799.
The Ahom kings ruled the Brahmaputra valley from the 13th century until Burma conquered it in 1817–21; Britain took it in 1826 (shown approximately).
No country owned Svalbard until the 1920 Svalbard Treaty. The source drew it inside Norway.
